state.message:
Christmas at a cabin in the Smokies, 5 nights from Dec 23, $2,450. Sam booked it and paid.

Jan and Mo are bringing the kids, Lily (4), Max (12) and Zoe (16). Grandma Rose is coming too, she doesn't drink.

Leo only makes it for the last 2 nights, and his girlfriend Tess comes with him. Uncle Ray drives up on the 25th, so 3 nights, with his son Ben (9).

Mo did the grocery run, $420, and Ana did the second one on the 26th, $185. Ana doesn't drink. Sam got the wine and beer, $180, and Ray brought the eggnog and whiskey, $95. Tess paid for everyone's sledding passes, $120.

host.desc: Id of the person hosting or booking the trip

exempt.desc: Ids of people the group agreed won't pay

people.desc: Adults on the trip, who pay

kids.desc: Kids on the trip; their guardians pay their share

expenses.desc: What was bought, in USD, and who paid

host_not_paying.desc: aityx's probability that the message says the host won't pay

age_weight.desc: Share of a full person's cost for a kid of this age
body: Kids up to the free age stay free.
Kids up to the half age pay half.
Older kids pay a full share.

share_of.desc: One person's share of one expense, in USD: drinks by drink weight, everything else by general weight
share_of.body: if kind = "drinks" then (if dt = 0 then 0 else amount * wd / dt) else (if gt = 0 then 0 else amount * wg / gt)

free_age.desc: Kids at or below this age stay free

half_age.desc: Kids at or below this age pay half

split_by_nights.desc: Weigh every share by nights stayed?

drinkers_split_drinks.desc: Split drinks only among the people who drink?

pay_days_before.desc: Days before the trip that transfers are due

evidence_threshold.desc: Minimum aityx probability to treat the host as not paying

weights.desc: Each person's weight for shared costs (age share times nights) and for drinks (nights, adults who drink)
weights.expr: concatenate(for p in people return {id: p.id, guardians: [], general: if split_by_nights then p.nights else 1, drink: if not(drinkers_split_drinks) or p.drinks then (if split_by_nights then p.nights else 1) else 0}, for k in kids return {id: k.id, guardians: k.guardians, general: age_weight(k.age, free_age, half_age) * (if split_by_nights then k.nights else 1), drink: 0})

general_total.desc: Sum of everyone's weight for shared costs

drink_total.desc: Sum of everyone's weight for drinks

shared_cost.desc: Lodging, groceries and other costs everyone shares, in USD

shares.desc: Each person's own share of the costs before kids and exemptions move, in USD
shares.expr: for w in weights return {id: w.id, guardians: w.guardians, owed: (if general_total = 0 then 0 else shared_cost * w.general / general_total) + (if drink_total = 0 then 0 else drinks_cost * w.drink / drink_total)}

payer_shares.desc: Each adult's share including their part of their kids' shares, split evenly between guardians, in USD
payer_shares.expr: for p in shares[count(guardians) = 0] return {id: p.id, owed: p.owed + sum(concatenate([0], for k in shares[list contains(guardians, p.id)] return k.owed / count(k.guardians)))}

host_exempt.desc: Does the message establish that the host won't pay?

exempt_ids.desc: Ids of the adults who don't pay
exempt_ids.expr: if host_exempt then distinct values(concatenate(exempt, [host])) else exempt

exempt_cost_total.desc: The shares of the adults who don't pay, in USD

covering_count.desc: How many adults cover the shares of those who don't pay

balances.desc: What each adult paid minus what they owe, with exempt shares split evenly among the others, in USD
balances.expr: for p in payer_shares return {id: p.id, net: sum(concatenate([0], expenses[paid_by = p.id].amount)) - (if list contains(exempt_ids, p.id) then 0 else p.owed + exempt_cost / covering)}

debtors.desc: Adults who owe money, largest first, in USD
debtors.expr: sort((for i in 1..count(balances) return {id: balances[i].id, i: i, v: 0 - balances[i].net})[v > 0], function(x, y) x.v > y.v or (x.v = y.v and x.i < y.i))

creditors.desc: Adults who are owed money, largest first, in USD
creditors.expr: sort((for i in 1..count(balances) return {id: balances[i].id, i: i, v: balances[i].net})[v > 0], function(x, y) x.v > y.v or (x.v = y.v and x.i < y.i))

transfers.desc: Who pays whom, in USD rounded to cents: the largest debts settle the largest credits first

let.debt_ends: if count(debtors) = 0 then [] else for k in 1..count(debtors) return sum(sublist(debtors.v, 1, k))

transfers.expr: if count(debtors) = 0 or count(creditors) = 0 then [] else (for i in 1..count(debtors), j in 1..count(creditors) return {from: debtors[i].id, to: creditors[j].id, amount: decimal(max(0, min(debt_ends[i], credit_ends[j]) - max(debt_ends[i] - debtors[i].v, credit_ends[j] - creditors[j].v)), 2)})[amount > 0]

receipts.desc: Each adult's receipt with what they owe overall (negative means they get money back) and the cents left over from rounding each line
receipts.expr: for r in receipt_lines return {id: r.id, lines: r.lines, owes: sum(concatenate([0], transfers[from = r.id].amount)) - sum(concatenate([0], transfers[to = r.id].amount)), rounding: decimal(sum(concatenate([0], transfers[from = r.id].amount)) - sum(concatenate([0], transfers[to = r.id].amount)) - sum(concatenate([0], r.lines.value)), 2)}

host_exempt.desc: Does the message establish that the host won't pay?

exempt_ids.desc: Ids of the adults who don't pay

exempt_cost_total.desc: The shares of the adults who don't pay, in USD

creditors.desc: Adults who are owed money, largest first, in USD
